journal.planner.title: Planner
journal.planner.subtitle: Prepare, schedule, and release publications.
journal.planner.restrictedViewport: The Planner needs a larger screen. Open it on a tablet or desktop.
journal.planner.noAccess: You don’t have Planner access in this campaign.
journal.planner.workbenchEmpty: Select a publication to build its release plan, or start a new draft.
journal.planner.whenReleasedHelp: Once its plan is satisfied it moves to the Library and becomes readable in the campaign.
journal.planner.deleteConfirm: Delete this publication? This can’t be undone.
journal.planner.noPlanYet: No release plan — add conditions or release manually.
journal.planner.contentGate: Add a title and content before releasing.
journal.planner.summaryReady: Ready to release — every condition is met and the content is complete.
journal.planner.summaryReadyNoContent: The plan is satisfied — add a title and content to send it out.
journal.planner.summaryNeedsPlan: No plan yet — this only goes out when you release it manually.
journal.planner.summaryPending: Waiting on the world — {{count}} condition(s) still need to be met before this goes out.
journal.planner.summaryBlocked: Blocked — this plan points at items that are missing or not visible here.
